Name: Gran Turismo
Description: A realistic racing simulator featuring a large roster of licensed cars, detailed physics, and a career mode that lets players earn licenses and upgrade vehicles.
Review: Astonishingly realistic for its time, though the licensing tests can feel like a slog.

Name: Grand Theft Auto V
Description: An open-world crime saga set in Los Santos following three protagonists whose stories intertwine through heists, satire, and sprawling exploration.
Review: A staggering open world packed with detail, even if the tone can feel mean-spirited at times.

Name: Super Mario World
Description: A side-scrolling platformer starring Mario and Yoshi as they traverse Dinosaur Land to rescue Princess Toadstool from Bowser.
Review: Tight, joyful platforming that still holds up decades later.

Name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
Description: Link travels between childhood and adulthood in Hyrule, wielding the Ocarina of Time to solve puzzles and defeat Ganondorf across sprawling 3D dungeons.
Review: A genre-defining adventure, though camera controls show their age.

Name: Halo: Combat Evolved
Description: Master Chief battles the alien Covenant on a mysterious ringworld in a sci-fi shooter praised for its vehicle combat and cooperative play.
Review: Revolutionized console shooters, with vehicle sections that still feel great.

Name: God of War
Description: Kratos and his son Atreus journey through Norse realms in a reimagining of the series that blends brutal combat with an intimate father-son story.
Review: A moving reinvention of the series with combat that feels weighty and precise.

Name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
Description: Monster hunter Geralt of Rivia searches for his adopted daughter across a vast open world shaped by morally complex choices and rich side quests.
Review: Side quests here are better than most games' main stories.

Name: Minecraft
Description: A block-based sandbox game where players mine resources, craft tools, and build anything from simple shelters to sprawling redstone machines.
Review: Practically limitless creative freedom, though the early grind can be slow for newcomers.

Name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
Description: Players cultivate a deserted island into a thriving community, decorating, fishing, and befriending anthropomorphic villagers at their own pace.
Review: A cozy, low-pressure escape, arriving right when the world needed one.

Name: Elden Ring
Description: An open-world dark fantasy epic co-created with George R. R. Martin, challenging players with punishing combat and a mysterious, sprawling Lands Between.
Review: Breathtaking scale and freedom, but brutally unforgiving for newcomers to the genre.

Name: Portal 2
Review: Whip-smart writing paired with genuinely clever puzzle design.
Description: Chell escapes Aperture Science using a portal gun to solve physics-based puzzles, joined by the sardonic AI GLaDOS and co-op robots Atlas and P-Body.

Name: Final Fantasy VII
Description: Cloud Strife and the eco-terrorist group AVALANCHE fight the Shinra corporation and the legendary soldier Sephiroth in a story spanning a planet-threatening crisis.
Review: An emotional epic that redefined what console RPGs could be.

Name: Street Fighter II
Description: A landmark competitive fighting game featuring a roster of eight playable World Warriors, popularizing combo systems and special move inputs.
Review: The template every fighting game since has borrowed from.

Name: Half-Life 2
Description: Gordon Freeman fights the totalitarian Combine regime in City 17 using the gravity gun and physics-driven puzzles in this influential shooter.
Review: The gravity gun alone reshaped how physics could be used in shooters.

Name: Red Dead Redemption 2
Description: Outlaw Arthur Morgan navigates the decline of the Wild West as his gang faces internal betrayal and encroaching civilization in a richly detailed frontier.
Review: Astonishingly detailed, though the deliberate pacing won't be for everyone.

Name: Chrono Trigger
Description: A time-traveling adventure across eras from prehistory to a dystopian future, renowned for its multiple endings and collaborative development team.
Review: Endlessly inventive, with a soundtrack that's aged beautifully.

Name: Overwatch
Description: A team-based hero shooter where players choose from a diverse cast of characters with unique abilities across objective-based game modes.
Review: Vibrant hero design and satisfying team play, though balance patches can be divisive.

Name: The Last of Us
Description: Joel and Ellie navigate a fungal-infection apocalypse across the ruins of the United States, blending stealth combat with an emotionally driven narrative.
Review: One of gaming's most affecting stories, carried by phenomenal performances.

Name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
Description: An enhanced kart racer with anti-gravity tracks, a large roster of Nintendo characters, and robust local and online multiplayer modes.
Review: The best couch multiplayer racer around, chaotic in all the right ways.

Name: Doom (2016)
Description: The Doom Slayer tears through demonic hordes on Mars in a fast-paced revival emphasizing aggressive movement and glory kills.
Review: A ferociously fast shooter that gets the original's spirit exactly right.

Name: Stardew Valley
Description: Players inherit a rundown farm and grow crops, raise animals, and build relationships with townsfolk in a cozy pixel-art life sim.
Review: Endless charm and an addictive farming loop, though grinding can feel repetitive late-game.

Name: Hades
Description: As the prince of the underworld, players fight through procedurally generated chambers to escape Hades' domain, growing stronger with each run.
Review: Gorgeous art and razor-sharp combat make every failed run feel rewarding.

Name: Candy Crush Saga
Description: A match-three puzzle game with thousands of levels, boosters, and social features that made it one of the most downloaded mobile games ever.
Review: Simple, addictive puzzle fun, though the monetization can feel aggressive.

Name: Pokemon Go
Description: Players explore the real world using their phone's camera and GPS to catch Pokemon, battle in gyms, and complete raids with other trainers nearby.
Review: A groundbreaking use of AR that got players outside, though the servers were rocky at launch.

Name: Beat Saber
Description: Players slice incoming blocks in time with music using motion-tracked lightsabers, blending rhythm-game precision with full-body movement.
Review: One of the best VR showcases around, exhilarating and easy to pick up.

Name: Sonic the Hedgehog
Description: Sonic races through Green Hill Zone and beyond at high speed to stop Dr. Robotnik, defined by momentum-based platforming and looping levels.
Review: Blisteringly fast platforming that defined Sega's identity in the 90s.

Name: Metal Gear Solid
Description: Solid Snake infiltrates a nuclear weapons facility to stop a rogue special forces unit, pioneering cinematic cutscenes and tactical stealth gameplay.
Review: A cinematic masterpiece that reinvented stealth gameplay with unforgettable characters.

Name: Guild Wars 2
Description: An MMORPG built around dynamic world events and large-scale WvW battles, notable for dropping traditional questing hubs and trinity-based combat.
Review: A refreshing MMO with dynamic events, though the story pacing can be uneven.

Name: Fortnite
Platform: PC / Xbox / PlayStation / Nintendo Switch / Mobile
Description: One hundred players fight to be the last one standing on a shrinking island, using scavenged weapons and a signature building mechanic.
Review: A cultural phenomenon blending building mechanics with battle royale chaos.

Name: Assassin's Creed II
Description: Ezio Auditore seeks revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family, climbing Renaissance Italy's cities in this landmark sequel.
Review: A huge leap over the original with a compelling revenge story across Renaissance Italy.

Name: Fallout 4
Description: A lone survivor wakes decades after a nuclear war to explore the ruins of Boston, building settlements and shaping the wasteland's factions.
Review: A sprawling post-apocalyptic playground let down by a middling main story.

Name: FIFA 23
Description: The final entry under the FIFA license simulates professional soccer with licensed leagues, HyperMotion animation capture, and cross-play modes.
Review: Solid on-pitch gameplay but plagued by familiar franchise mode complaints.

Name: League of Legends
Description: Two teams of five champions battle across three lanes to destroy the enemy Nexus, becoming one of the most-watched esports in the world.
Review: A deep strategic MOBA that remains fun, though the toxic community can be discouraging.

Name: Dark Souls
Description: Players explore the interconnected, decaying kingdom of Lordran, fighting punishing bosses and uncovering lore through environmental storytelling.
Review: Punishingly difficult but deeply satisfying, with masterful level design.

Name: Hollow Knight
Description: Players explore the ruined insect kingdom of Hallownest, gaining new abilities to reach previously inaccessible areas in this hand-drawn adventure.
Review: A gorgeous, atmospheric metroidvania with tight combat and rewarding exploration.
